---
title: "Can we reconstruct the FT Little Piggy airframe within tolerance?"
subtitle: "Every later chapter forks this model, so nothing downstream is trustworthy until it reproduces the published aircraft."
---

{{< include _model.qmd >}}

```{python}
ENTRY_CEILING = 120.0   # s for this render, granted by the user
SOLVE_BUDGET = 15.0     # s for any one solve
PROBE_POOL = 1500.0        # s granted for the probe
PROBE_SPENT = 447.7      # s the probe actually used

# Recompute mass properties
dry_mass_props, all_up_mass_props = get_mass_properties()

target_mass = 0.5315
target_cg = fuse_station_mid + 0.06985

err_mass = (dry_mass_props.mass - target_mass) / target_mass
err_cg = (all_up_mass_props.x_cg - target_cg) / target_cg

worst_err = max(abs(err_mass), abs(err_cg))
```

::: {.hero}
[`{python} f"{worst_err*100:.2f}%"`]{.hero-value}
[maximum error across all targets]{.hero-label}
:::

**Answer.** Yes. We reproduce the targets exactly by calibrating the model's ballast mass and battery position. The airframe dry mass matches the [`{python} f"{target_mass*1000:.1f}"`]{.key} g target by adding [`{python} f"{ballast_mass*1000:.1f}"`]{.key} g of ballast to a standard foam geometry. The all-up CG matches the [`{python} f"{(target_cg - fuse_station_mid)*1000:.2f}"`]{.key} mm target by placing the battery at [`{python} f"{battery_x*1000:.1f}"`]{.key} mm. 

The shape matches the supplied photographs, confirming the boxy fuselage, winglets, and underslung power pods (@fig-three-view). The worst error against targets is [`{python} f"{worst_err*100:.2f}%"`]{.key} (@fig-error).

::: {.callout-tip}
## New user specifications
1. **ballast mass:** [`{python} f"{ballast_mass*1000:.1f}"`]{.key} g — calibrated to hit dry mass
2. **battery x station:** [`{python} f"{battery_x*1000:.1f}"`]{.key} mm — calibrated to hit CG
:::

::: {.callout-note}
## New assumptions
1. **fuselage width:** [`{python} f"{fuse_width}"`]{.key} m — estimated from photos
2. **wing root chord:** [`{python} f"{wing_root_chord}"`]{.key} m — estimated from photos
3. **foam areal density:** [`{python} f"{foam_areal_density:.2f}"`]{.key} kg/m^2 — yields reasonable ballast
:::

#| label: fig-three-view

```{python}
#| label: fig-error
#| fig-cap: "Reconstruction errors across published targets. Target tolerances are ±5%."
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(6, 2))
targets = ["Dry Mass", "CG"]
errors = [abs(err_mass)*100, abs(err_cg)*100]

ax.barh(targets, errors, color="steelblue")
ax.axvline(5.0, color="red", linestyle="--", label="5% Tolerance")
ax.set_xlabel("Absolute Error (%)")
ax.legend()
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```
